facts.fact: Heirs Technologies, citing Data Center Map, reports 18 active data centres in Kenya, with a Nairobi/Mombasa cluster of operators including Digital Realty, iXAfrica, Telkom, PAIX and Safaricom; no individual facility, tier or opening date is given, so as_of is the report's published date (2025-11).
facts.system: Kenya Nairobi/Mombasa data centre cluster (Digital Realty, iXAfrica, Telkom, PAIX, Safaricom)

note: No cloud fact: Oracle region in Kenya only announced (2024); Data Center Map lists AWS, Azure and Oracle as Nairobi cloud providers without stating a live region. No Kenya tier statement (Tier III is stated for Nigeria only).
